sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: The Plinth House is a 3,000 sqm private villa on the coast of Abu Alhusaniya, Kuwait, completed in 2025. Designed by Cambra Buró under a full architectural, interior, and landscape scope, the house is structured as a dialogue between restraint and expression: a sculpted travertine plinth anchors the building to the ground, while a minimal, calm upper volume rests above it, deliberately understated in contrast to the base.
